title: Sprint Overlap Issues
scenario: Find bugs that were reported in one sprint but not resolved until three sprints later.
tableSchema: bugs (bug_id INT, created_at TIMESTAMP), status_history (bug_id INT, changed_at TIMESTAMP), sprints (sprint_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE)
hint: Join bugs and resolved status with sprint start/end dates.
correctQuery: SELECT b.bug_id FROM bugs b JOIN status_history sh ON b.bug_id = sh.bug_id JOIN sprints s1 ON b.created_at::DATE BETWEEN s1.start_date AND s1.end_date JOIN sprints s2 ON sh.changed_at::DATE BETWEEN s2.start_date AND s2.end_date WHERE sh.status = 'Resolved' AND s2.sprint_id >= s1.sprint_id + 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE bugs (bug_id INT, created_at TIMESTAMP); CREATE TABLE status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP); CREATE TABLE sprints (sprint_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE);
